data.name: Kushner-Netanyahu talks on Trump Gaza plan
data.description: Reuters reported that Jared Kushner met Benjamin Netanyahu for nearly four hours while attempting to revive the U.S. Gaza plan; the talks ended without a breakthrough on the central sequencing disputes.
data.outcome: No breakthrough was reported; working groups were agreed while core sequencing disputes remained.
actions: Discussed disarmament, Israeli withdrawal, reconstruction and implementation sequencing under the Trump Gaza plan.
